about: RFQ details beta inbox: 22 emails copied from sample_emails.json with 30 real attachment files. 13 files are uncopyable (image-only scans, a fax, a phone photo, a screenshot), so their text comes from OCR. Built by tools/make_rfq_beta.py. All companies and people are fictional; 'expected' is the answer key.

emails.subject: RFQ 26-0412: Sensor mounting bracket, 6061-T6
emails.body:
Hi team,

Please quote the attached sensor mounting bracket, P/N QA-41127 Rev B.

Material: 6061-T6 aluminum
Finish: Black anodize per MIL-A-8625 Type II, Class 2
Quantities: 25 / 50 / 100
Inspection: standard, FAI on the first lot

Quote due by October 3. Let me know if you have any questions on the tolerances.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Buyer, Quillon Aerospace

expected.note: Simple prismatic bracket, full info, anodize is outside processing.

emails.subject: LINE DOWN: need 4 knife holder blocks this week
emails.body:
Mesa Ridge,

One of our cartoners at a customer plant in Mesa is down. The knife holder block cracked through the bolt boss and we have no spares on the shelf. I'm out at the plant with no scanner, so I took a photo of the print, OPM-22817 Rev B.

Need 4 pcs (2 to get the machine running, 2 for our spares stock). 4140 pre-hard 28-32 HRC, black oxide per the print. If the black oxide slows you down, leave them bare and oiled and we'll deal with it later.

Can you quote today and tell me how fast you can have them? We need them this week: tomorrow if your shop runs Saturdays, Monday morning at the absolute latest. We'll pay expedite and overtime, and our field tech will pick them up at your dock.

Declan Foyle
Field Service Manager, Oxbow Packaging Machinery
Cell 480-555-0147

expected.note: Line-down rush on a prismatic steel block for an OEM field repair, needed this week.

emails.subject: RFQ: fold mirror mount LO-1186 Rev A, compound-angle seat
emails.body:
Hello Mesa Ridge,

Can you quote the fold mirror mount LO-1186 Rev A? The PDF is still stuck in our PDM release queue, so I attached a screenshot of the drawing. 6061-T651, black anodize per MIL-A-8625 Type II Class 2 with the pads and bores masked.

No model on this one; the drawing is fully dimensioned. The mirror seat is tilted 22.5° about X and 11.25° about Y, and the three kinematic pads, the beam bore, and the retainer holes are all normal to that compound face. Pads are .0002 flat and coplanar within .0003, so I'd expect a 5-axis or at least a 3+2 setup.

Qty 8, possibly 25 more later this year. C of C and material certs, nothing fancier.

Could you get back to me by Oct 12?

Thanks,
Felix Durand
Optomechanical Engineer
Lucerne Optomechanics

expected.note: Compound-angle optical mount with no STEP; the drawing alone defines the 5-axis geometry.
